dedupe_keys.name: sl gtfs schedule and real time transit data

description: SL: GTFS schedule and real-time transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by SL. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Gävleborg County, Gävleborg County, Sweden, with real-time vehicle, trip or alert feeds. Coverage: Gävleborg County, Gävleborg County, Sweden. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed and 3 GTFS Realtime feeds for this provider (Gävleborg County, Gävleborg County, Sweden). At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge but needs registration according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is licence given by link only (https://www.trafiklab.se/api/gtfs-datasets/gtfs-regional/#licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
